chapter: Brawls, the Ink Spots and boyhood recollections
title: Hitting Ed Small and the waiters
summary: When Small pushes his wife away, Bubbles knocks him out, then a waiter, and the crowd joins a free-for-all as he ducks away.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: bowl -- wouldn't I say I broke the bowl for a dollar and -- how much is it. If it was two dollars, wouldn't I say what I (inaudible)? My name is Bubbles. Why would I worry about a dollar and a half bowl for. Do you know what I mean. I wouldn't have no kind of ruckus about no kind of bowl. Do you know one of the waiters told Ed Small and as we're going out, Ed Small stopped us at the door and says, "Did you pay for the bowl?" I said, "What bowl?" "The boss says you broke a bowl. I said I wasn't breaking no bowl. "Oh, yes you did." Why would you say that? My wife got made because I said "I didn't break it" and Ed Small says that I did. Now that made my wife mad. This is my first wife now. So my wife steps in front of me and says to Ed Small, "He didn't break the bowl." He says, "I'm not talking to you." She says, "But you're talking to my husband," she says. He says, "I don't care if I was talking to your mother," says he to her. Now I can't say nothin' 'cause

I'm very quick tempered. I just got to go through everything and get it out the way. So what did I do? I just said -- when he went to push her away from me, push her back out of the way 'cause he's talking to me, I just lift my hand out and help him push her back. And when I got my hand back far enough I come and I hit him right up side of the head with my hand, knocked him down, knocked him out, 'cause I had to drag him out of there. Okay?

Now, when they dragged him out then all the waiters they're goin' to jump on me because they all carried knives and everything. They were tough bunch and they would fight for Ed Small. So they're going to jump on me. So my partner was at the door trying to tell the waiters that I didn't do it. "He didn't do it." "He didn't do it." So the first waiter that got by my partner came to me, I had my hand alongside of me and said, "No, I didn't do that." "I didn't break the bowl."
Now he ain't satisfied when I

said that. He said, 'Oh, yes, you did.' And I hit him. Down he went. Now you wouldn't think that I could hit two -- don't tell me. And Jesus was with me, too. I had God on my side, too, 'cause I was right. 'Cause God was helping me hit him. Anyway, that was that. Now, the public got in it. They saw the whole thing, what people were near it saw it. They come out and joined it. They started fighting, waiters was fighting, everybody was fighting on account of me and Buck. And they were trying to stop the thing and while they were fighting and all crowded on me, I just saw so many pictures, just like I told you about that thing in Naptown, when I come out behind that box. Listen, I'll just say one thing -- let me get out of here.
